name: AGENT_IMAGE
description: Default workload image (docker, kata).

name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
description: Same, for Anthropic.

name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
description: Snapshot-tier credentials.

name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
description: Snapshot-tier credentials.

name: BUNDLE_S3_BUCKET
description: Bundle bucket.

name: BUNDLE_S3_ENDPOINT
description: Where agent bundles are fetched from.

name: DATABASE_URL
description: Postgres DSN (pgvector image). Also read by `cmd/migrate` and the cron scheduler.

name: DOCKER_SOCKET
description: Docker socket path.

name: FC_BINARY_PATH
description: Firecracker binary.

name: FC_BRIDGE
description: Host bridge for VM taps.

name: FC_KERNEL_PATH
description: Guest kernel.

name: FC_ROOTFS_PATH
description: Base rootfs image.

name: FIRECRACKER_CHROOT_BASE
description: Jailer chroot base.

name: FIRECRACKER_JAILER_GID
description: Gid the jailer drops to.

name: FIRECRACKER_JAILER_PATH
description: Run Firecracker under this `jailer` binary.

name: FIRECRACKER_JAILER_UID
description: Uid the jailer drops to.

name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
description: Enables "Sign in with Google" (with the secret).

name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
description: Google OAuth client secret.

name: HTTP_ADDR
description: REST listen address.

name: JWT_SECRET
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Signs dashboard JWTs. Unset or the dev default is fatal in prod. **Required in prod.**

name: KATA_RUNTIME_NAME
description: Docker runtime name registered for Kata.

name: LISTEN_ADDR
description: gRPC listen address (the tenant-trust boundary).

name: LOG_LEVEL
description: Log level.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
description: Control-plane URL for the browser and the kiosk page.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE
description: `1` shows the demo affordances on the login page.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAL_BRIDGE_URL
description: Public fallback for the same URL, and the Surfaces page probe.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAL_IMESSAGE_BRIDGE_URL
description: Public fallback, and the Surfaces page probe.

name: NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
description: Turnstile site key; renders the captcha widget.

name: NODE_ADVERTISE_ADDR
description: Address the scheduler dials back; set it on multi-host.

name: NODE_ENV
description: `production` marks the session cookie `Secure`.

name: NODE_NAME
description: Node name reported to the scheduler.

name: NODE_REGION
description: Region label for placement.

name: NODE_ZONE
description: Zone label.

name: OAUTH_BASE_URL
description: Public base URL for connector OAuth redirect URIs.

name: OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_
description: Per-connector OAuth client id; connector id upper-cased, `-` as `_` (for example `OAUTH_CLIENT_ID_GITHUB`).

name: OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_
description: The matching client secret.

name: OAUTH_DASHBOARD_URL
description: Dashboard base URL used in emailed verify/reset links and OAuth redirects.

name: OAUTH_REDIRECT_BASE
description: Base URL for the Google sign-in redirect URI. Set it to the public API URL.

name: OPENAI_API_KEY
description: Platform-level fallback provider key, used when a tenant has none configured.

name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
description: Standard OTLP endpoint; setting it also enables tracing.

name: PAL_AGENT_DIR
description: Agent directory the Python runtime runner loads when none is passed.

name: PAL_AGENT_IDENTITY_ED25519_SEED
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Seed for Ed25519 agent identity tokens (preferred over the HMAC secret).

name: PAL_AGENT_IDENTITY_SECRET
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: HMAC secret for per-instance agent identity tokens.

name: PAL_AGENT_IDENTITY_TTL
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Identity token lifetime (Go duration).

name: PAL_AGENT_INSTANCE_ID
description: Injected into spawned workloads, not an operator setting.

name: PAL_AGENT_INSTANCE_TOKEN
description: Injected into spawned workloads, not an operator setting.

name: PAL_AGENT_NAME
description: Agent name of the running workload.

name: PAL_AGENT_VERSION
description: Agent version of the running workload.

name: PAL_ALLOW_RUNC_STANDARD
description: `1`/`true`/`yes`/`on` lets the `standard` class run on plain runc (admin override).

name: PAL_ALLOW_SECRET_STUB
description: `1`: read secrets from the harness's own env instead of the manager. Dev only; never in production.

name: PAL_API_KEY
description: Appears only in the generated "view code" samples; the dashboard itself does not read it.

name: PAL_API_URL
description: Control-plane URL for server-side calls (checked before `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`).

name: PAL_APP_DB_PASSWORD
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Password of the non-superuser `pal_app` role used when RLS is enforced. Setting it turns RLS on in production; if it is missing, startup is fatal unless `PAL_RLS_ENFORCE=0`. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_APP_DB_USER
description: Restricted database role that tenant-scoped work connects as when RLS is enforced.

name: PAL_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Retention for audit events.

name: PAL_AUTHZ_ENFORCE
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
default: on in production, off in dev
description: Scope enforcement is on by default in production (`PAL_ENV=production|staging`) and off in dev. `=0` opts out (logged as a warning); `=1` forces it on in dev. A key missing the endpoint's scope then gets 403.

name: PAL_BATCH_MAX_ITEMS
description: Maximum items in one `POST /v1/batches` request (ADR 0033).

name: PAL_BILLING_GRACE_DAYS
description: Days of dunning grace before a failed payment drops the tenant to free limits (0 to 60). Data is never deleted.

name: PAL_BILLING_SYNC_INTERVAL
description: Cadence of the dunning sweep and the meter export.

name: PAL_BRIDGE_HEARTBEAT_TOKEN
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Shared token for `POST /v1/surfaces/whatsapp/heartbeat`.

name: PAL_BRIDGE_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
description: Retries for 429/503/network errors to the control plane.

name: PAL_BRIDGE_RETRY_BASE_MS
description: Backoff base step.

name: PAL_BRIDGE_RETRY_MAX_MS
description: Backoff cap (full jitter).

name: PAL_BRIDGE_TOKEN
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Token the WhatsApp bridge validates.

name: PAL_BRIDGE_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: WhatsApp bridge base URL.

name: PAL_BROWSER_SKILL
description: `on`/`1`/`true` enables browser-as-skill.

name: PAL_CALLBACK_SIGNING_SECRET
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Key for the HMAC-SHA256 `X-Pal-Signature` on run and batch callbacks. Fatal in prod when unset; in dev a well-known default is used. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_CC_MEASUREMENT_PATH
description: File holding the launch measurement.

name: PAL_CC_TECH
description: Confidential-computing technology to report.

name: PAL_CLAIM_VERIFY
description: Claim-verify guard on completed-action claims. `0`/`off`/`false` disables; read on every call.

name: PAL_CLAUDE_BINARY
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Explicit path to that binary.

name: PAL_COMMITMENT_LEDGER
description: `0` disables closing open commitments from verbatim evidence.

name: PAL_COMPLEXITY_ROUTING
description: Complexity-based model routing. `0`/`off`/`false` disables.

name: PAL_CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATE
description: Lowers the score by the step type's realized regret rate.

name: PAL_CONFIDENCE_ESTIMATOR
description: `self-consistency` (also `self_consistency`, `sampling`) polls the model; anything else uses the heuristic.

name: PAL_CONFIDENCE_GATE
description: `1`/`true`/`on` diverts low-confidence tool and connector steps to approval. See [Human-in-the-loop](/docs/pal/human-in-the-loop/).

name: PAL_CONFIDENCE_GATE_THRESHOLD
description: Minimum score in [0,1] for auto-execution.

name: PAL_CONFIDENCE_SAMPLES
description: Independent judgments per self-consistency estimate; each is one LLM call.

name: PAL_CONFIDENTIAL
description: Marks a confidential-computing VM for attestation.

name: PAL_CONTROL_PLANE_ENDPOINTS
description: Ordered, comma-separated control-plane endpoints, primary region first; the data-plane agent fails over down the list.

name: PAL_CONTROL_PLANE_FAILBACK_INTERVAL
description: How often the data-plane agent probes the primary endpoint to fail back after a failover.

name: PAL_CONTROL_PLANE_TLS_CERT
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: PEM path for the gRPC server certificate. Both cert and key, or neither; one alone is always fatal. Prod requires them. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_CONTROL_PLANE_TLS_KEY
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: PEM path for the matching key. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_CONTROL_PLANE_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Control plane's own public URL (errand callbacks); also what the manager uses for the secret relay.

name: PAL_CORS_ORIGINS
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Comma-separated allowed browser origins. Public endpoints (receipt verify, `/.well-known/*`) stay open.

name: PAL_CREDENTIAL_KEY
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: 32-byte AES-256-GCM key that encrypts provider keys and connector tokens at rest. Fatal in prod when unset or malformed. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_CROSS_APP
description: `on`/`1`/`true` enables cross-app workflows.

name: PAL_DECLARED_SECRETS
description: Secret refs the spec declared.

name: PAL_DEFAULT_CALENDAR
description: Calendar used when a booking names none.

name: PAL_DEFAULT_MANAGER_ADDR
description: Manager address for the log-stream proxy and the health sweep.

name: PAL_DEFAULT_TENANT_ID
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Tenant that single-owner background jobs act for.

name: PAL_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE
description: IANA zone for cron matching and the budget day boundary when a schedule sets none.

name: PAL_DIALER
description: `stub` forces the stub dialer. Fatal in prod.

name: PAL_DISLIKE_LLM_CLUSTER
description: `0` disables the LLM clustering pass of the thumbs-down learning loop (the deterministic pass always runs).

name: PAL_DL_SIGNING_SECRET
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Signing secret for short-lived document download links.

name: PAL_DP_MAX_STREAMS_PER_TENANT
description: Concurrent data-plane run streams per tenant.

name: PAL_DRAFT_CONFIRM
description: iMessage: `on` holds LOW-confidence replies for owner approval.

name: PAL_DRAFT_HIGH_STAKES
description: WhatsApp: `on` holds LOW-confidence replies for owner approval.

name: PAL_DRAIN_GRACE_SECS
description: Grace period on SIGTERM drain.

name: PAL_DRAIN_TIMEOUT
description: Graceful-shutdown drain window (Go duration).

name: PAL_EGRESS_ALLOWED_PORTS
description: Comma list of ports the broker will dial.

name: PAL_EGRESS_BIND
description: Listen address of the in-guest egress proxy.

name: PAL_EGRESS_CA_PEM
description: Per-VM CA the broker uses to terminate TLS for injecting hosts.

name: PAL_EGRESS_FAIL_CLOSED
description: `1` refuses to boot without the iptables REDIRECT rule. Always on in prod; `0` is ignored there with a warning.

name: PAL_EGRESS_MODE
description: `broker` (Firecracker only) gives VMs no NIC and enforces egress on the host over vsock. See [Egress and credentials](/docs/security/egress/).

name: PAL_EGRESS_PLAIN_INJECT
description: `1` permits credential injection over plain HTTP on port 80. Off by default.

name: PAL_EGRESS_RULES
description: JSON `[{pattern, http_methods, rate_bps}]` declared egress.

name: PAL_EGRESS_VSOCK_PORT
description: Broker-mode vsock port to the host broker.

name: PAL_EMBED_CONCURRENCY
description: Parallel embedding calls.

name: PAL_EMBED_MODEL
description: Embedding model for knowledge and memory.

name: PAL_ENV
description: `prod`, `production` or `staging` turns on every production startup guard in this table. The Helm chart defaults it to `production`.

name: PAL_ERRAND
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Enables outbound errand calls.

name: PAL_ERRAND_PUBLIC_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Public URL for errand webhooks.

name: PAL_EVENT_SCOUT
description: `0` disables the weekly event scan (commands still work).

name: PAL_EVENT_SCOUT_AGENT
description: Registered agent name event-scout sessions run under.

name: PAL_EVENT_SCOUT_AUDIENCE
description: Audience the event scout curates for.

name: PAL_EVENT_SCOUT_LOCATION
description: Location the event scout searches around.

name: PAL_EVENT_SCOUT_WA
description: `1` enables the scheduled event scan on WhatsApp too.

name: PAL_FENCE_EPOCH
description: Positive-integer fencing epoch for failover; a stale region cannot write after a newer epoch is promoted. See `docs/runbooks/region-failover.md`.

name: PAL_FORK_CONCURRENCY
description: Concurrent fork spawns.

name: PAL_FREE_TIER_COST_USD_PER_DAY
description: Tenant-wide LLM spend cap applied to new tenants.

name: PAL_FREE_TIER_MAX_VMS
description: Concurrent sandbox VMs for new tenants.

name: PAL_FREE_TIER_RUNTIME_COST_USD_PER_DAY
description: Sandbox spend cap for new tenants.

name: PAL_GRPC_INSECURE
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: `1` lets a prod-like process serve or dial internal gRPC without mutual TLS, with a loud warning.

name: PAL_GRPC_SERVICE_TOKEN
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Shared service token for the gRPC trust boundaries. Set the same value on the control plane, gateway, workflow engine, runtime scheduler, model router and runtime manager. Fatal in prod when unset; dev warns and allows unauthenticated calls. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_GRPC_TLS_ALLOWED_PEERS
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Comma-separated SPIFFE ids (`spiffe://pal.internal/svc/<name>`) this server accepts. Per-VM guest certificates are always refused.

name: PAL_GRPC_TLS_CA
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: CA bundle for mutual TLS on internal gRPC hops (ADR 0043). Set with `_CERT` and `_KEY`.

name: PAL_GRPC_TLS_CERT
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: This process's service certificate for internal gRPC mutual TLS.

name: PAL_GRPC_TLS_KEY
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Private key for `PAL_GRPC_TLS_CERT`.

name: PAL_HAIKU_MODEL
description: Concrete model behind the small tier.

name: PAL_HARNESS_EXEC_ADDR
description: Listen address of the one-shot exec server.

name: PAL_HARNESS_EXEC_PORT
description: Port of the harness exec channel.

name: PAL_HARNESS_EXEC_TOKEN
description: Token the Exec RPC requires. Must be set in prod and staging. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_HARNESS_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
description: How long resume and fork wait for the harness.

name: PAL_HEALTH_SWEEP_INTERVAL
description: Peer-service health sweep period. `0` or `off` disables it.

name: PAL_HOME
description: CLI config and credentials directory.

name: PAL_HOOK_BURST
description: Per-trigger burst.

name: PAL_HOOK_RATE_PER_MIN
description: Per-trigger rate limit on `POST /v1/hooks/{id}`.

name: PAL_IMESSAGE_BRIDGE_TOKEN
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Token the iMessage bridge validates (a different variable from the WhatsApp one).

name: PAL_IMESSAGE_BRIDGE_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: iMessage bridge base URL.

name: PAL_IMESSAGE_OWNER_HANDLE
description: Owner iMessage handle for dedicated-bot mode; unset falls back to self-chat detection.

name: PAL_IMMIGRATION_SENTINEL
description: `on` enables the document-deadline sentinel, which derives deadlines from documents and mail (control plane).

name: PAL_JARVIS_BRIEF_CHANNEL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Channel for the brief.

name: PAL_JARVIS_BRIEF_HOUR
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Hour 0 to 23 for the morning brief push.

name: PAL_JOURNAL_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Retention for `journal_events`.

name: PAL_KB_MIN_SCORE
description: Cosine floor for a knowledge-base vector hit; below it the full-text fallback runs.

name: PAL_KIOSK
description: Demo mode: anonymous throwaway workspaces. Refuses to start unless RLS and authz enforcement are on and `JWT_SECRET` is non-default.

name: PAL_KIOSK_ALLOW_PROD
description: Required to run kiosk mode under a production-like `PAL_ENV`.

name: PAL_KIOSK_IP_PER_HOUR
description: New workspaces per client IP per hour.

name: PAL_KIOSK_MAX_SESSIONS
description: Concurrent kiosk workspaces.

name: PAL_KIOSK_SWEEP_SEC
description: Expiry sweep period in seconds.

name: PAL_KIOSK_TTL_MIN
description: Workspace lifetime in minutes.

name: PAL_LIVE_WATCH
description: `0`/`off` disables live watches (follow-ups on a flight, game or outage a contact mentioned).

name: PAL_LLM_BASEURL_ANTHROPIC
description: Same, for Anthropic.

name: PAL_LLM_BASEURL_OPENAI
description: Points OpenAI calls at a fixture or proxy base URL (used by demo mode and the replay server).

name: PAL_LLM_MAX_TURNS
description: Tool-loop turn limit per completion.

name: PAL_MAC_USAGE
description: `on` enables the owner-only Mac app-usage signal (summaries only, fails closed).

name: PAL_MAC_USAGE_SEC
description: Mac app-usage refresh interval in seconds (min 60).

name: PAL_MAIL_FROM
description: From address for `smtp` and `http`.

name: PAL_MAIL_HTTP_TOKEN
description: Bearer token for the `http` driver.

name: PAL_MAIL_HTTP_URL
description: Endpoint for the `http` driver.

name: PAL_MAIL_INDEX
description: `0`/`off` disables the owner-only search over the local Apple Mail index.

name: PAL_MAILER
description: `log`, `smtp` or `http`.

name: PAL_MANAGER_ADDR
description: Manager address; in broker mode the manager's name, dialed over vsock.

name: PAL_MANAGER_SERVER_NAME
description: TLS server name used to verify the manager.

name: PAL_MANAGER_TLS_CA
description: CA that harness and caller client certs must chain to. Fail-closed in prod, plaintext with a warning in dev. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_MANAGER_TLS_CERT
description: Manager server certificate (PEM). **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_MANAGER_TLS_KEY
description: Manager server key (PEM). **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_MANAGER_VSOCK_PORT
description: Broker mode: vsock port of the control channel.

name: PAL_MAX_FORK_COUNT
description: Per-call cap on `POST /v1/runtime/vms/{id}/fork`.

name: PAL_MAX_RESTARTS
description: Workload restart limit.

name: PAL_MEMORY_DISTILL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: `1`/`true`/`on` enables LLM memory distillation.

name: PAL_MEMORY_DISTILL_INTERVAL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Distillation period.

name: PAL_MEMORY_INGEST
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Background memory ingest. `off` disables.

name: PAL_MEMORY_INGEST_INTERVAL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Ingest period.

name: PAL_METRICS_ADDR
description: Separate Prometheus `/metrics` listener. Unauthenticated and labelled with agent names, so scrape it from Prometheus only, never through ingress.

name: PAL_MODEL_ROUTER_ADDR
description: Model router address; also a health-sweep target.

name: PAL_MULTI_STEP_PLANNER
description: Multi-step planner. `0`/`off`/`false` disables.

name: PAL_NO_PROXY
description: Overrides the injected `NO_PROXY`.

name: PAL_NODE_LABEL_GVISOR
description: Node label that marks gVisor-capable nodes.

name: PAL_NODE_LABEL_KATA
description: Node label that marks Kata-capable nodes.

name: PAL_NODE_MEMORY_BYTES
description: Override the advertised memory in bytes. Default: detected, else 8 GiB with a warning.

name: PAL_NODE_VCPU_MILLIS
description: Override the advertised CPU capacity in millicores. Default: detected parallelism x 1000.

name: PAL_OPUS_MODEL
description: Concrete model behind the large tier.

name: PAL_OTEL_ENABLED
description: `1` enables tracing (with an OTLP endpoint).

name: PAL_OTLP_SOCKET
description: Unix socket for workload OTLP.

name: PAL_OWNER_EMAIL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Owner email: brief fallback and memory-ingest identity.

name: PAL_OWNER_NAME
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Owner first name for briefs and calls.

name: PAL_OWNER_PHONE
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Owner number for the morning brief by SMS.

name: PAL_OWNER_PROFILE
description: Owner profile markdown (facts, relationships, style lessons), hot-reloaded.

name: PAL_OWNER_TIMEZONE
description: IANA timezone for quiet hours, digests and calendar lookups.

name: PAL_OWNER_VERIFY_PIN
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: PIN for the owner's Twilio line; unset authorizes on caller ID alone (spoofable).

name: PAL_OWNER_VERIFY_TTL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: How long a PIN verification lasts.

name: PAL_PERSONAL_DOCS_BRIDGE_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Overrides the bridge URL for the personal-docs tool.

name: PAL_PERSONAL_DOCS_OCR_MAX_PAGES
description: Max PDF pages rendered and OCR-ed per file.

name: PAL_PERSONAL_DOCS_ROOTS
description: Colon-separated roots the personal-docs search may read. Everything else is blocked.

name: PAL_PG_MAX_CONN_IDLE_TIME
description: Max connection idle time.

name: PAL_PG_MAX_CONN_LIFETIME
description: Max connection lifetime.

name: PAL_PG_MAX_CONNS
description: Postgres pool size.

name: PAL_PROACTIVE_NUDGES
description: `0` disables anticipation nudges (pre-meeting, overdue reply, dates, commitments).

name: PAL_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: Public URL override for Twilio callbacks.

name: PAL_QUIET_END
description: Quiet hours end (24h); the queue replays with morning pacing.

name: PAL_QUIET_QUEUE_MAX
description: Max messages buffered overnight per bridge.

name: PAL_QUIET_START
description: Quiet hours start (24h). Inbound is queued, not answered.

name: PAL_RCS_INBOUND
group: Control plane: personal-assistant and bridge integration
description: `on` accepts inbound RCS.

name: PAL_READ_ONLY
description: `1`/`true`/`on` makes this region a read-only standby that rejects writes; `0`/`false`/`off` is writable. Anything else fails startup.

name: PAL_REAPER_INTERVAL_SECS
description: Orphan-VM reaper period (minimum 1).

name: PAL_RECEIPT_ED25519_SEED
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Seed for the Ed25519 receipt key. Unset: receipts fall back to HMAC and cannot be verified offline by third parties.

name: PAL_RECEIPT_SECRET
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: HMAC secret for run receipts and marketplace invocation signatures. Fatal in prod when unset. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_RECOVERY_INTERVAL
description: Crash-recovery sweep period.

name: PAL_REDIS_POOL_SIZE
description: Redis pool size.

name: PAL_REGION
description: Region label for active-passive multi-region (lowercase `[a-z0-9-]`, 1-63 chars). A malformed value fails startup. ADR 0046.

name: PAL_RLIMIT_AS_BYTES
description: Address-space limit applied to the workload.

name: PAL_RLS_ENFORCE
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
default: on in production when `PAL_APP_DB_PASSWORD` is set
description: Row-level security is on in production whenever `PAL_APP_DB_PASSWORD` is set. Without that password the control plane refuses to start unless you set `PAL_RLS_ENFORCE=0`. `1` enforces it elsewhere through the `pal_app` pool.

name: PAL_ROUTE_STRATEGY
description: `balanced`, `cheap`, `quality` or `fast` for `model: auto`.

name: PAL_RUN_DIR
description: Directory for sockets (`secrets.sock`).

name: PAL_RUN_ID
description: Run id of the running workload.

name: PAL_RUN_LEASE_TTL
description: Run lease length; renewed every third of it while a run executes.

name: PAL_RUNTIME
description: `true` inside a running agent: enables the production sidecar in the SDK.

name: PAL_RUNTIME_CLASS
description: RuntimeClass the pod runs under (attestation).

name: PAL_RUNTIME_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
description: Retention for `runtime_vm_logs`.

name: PAL_RUNTIME_MANAGER_ADDR
description: Runtime manager, for exec, pause and fork calls. Unset: those routes are unavailable.

name: PAL_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TLS_CA
description: CA used to verify the manager. Prod requires mTLS to the manager; dev allows plaintext. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TLS_CERT
description: Client certificate (both cert and key, or neither). Prod requires it. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_RUNTIME_MANAGER_TLS_KEY
description: Client key. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_RUNTIME_RELAY_ALLOW_INSECURE
description: `1` allows a non-TLS relay URL (dev only).

name: PAL_RUNTIME_SECRET_TOKEN
group: Control plane: auth, secrets, trust boundaries
description: Pre-shared token for the manager-to-control-plane secret relay. Unset: `POST /v1/runtime/secrets/resolve` returns 403.

name: PAL_RUNTIME_TERMINAL_GRACE
description: How long after a VM turns terminal the control plane still accepts its late log and audit reports. `0` disables the window.

name: PAL_RUNTIMECLASS_GVISOR
description: Kubernetes RuntimeClass for gVisor. Unset: that class is refused (fail-closed).

name: PAL_RUNTIMECLASS_KATA
description: RuntimeClass for Kata.

name: PAL_RUNTIMECLASS_KATA_CC
description: RuntimeClass for confidential Kata.

name: PAL_RUNTIMECLASS_WASM
description: RuntimeClass for Wasm pods.

name: PAL_SCHEDULER_GRPC_ADDR
description: Runtime scheduler, for example `localhost:50055`. Unset uses a stub that fabricates VM ids and spawns nothing, so prod refuses to start. **Required in prod.**

name: PAL_SECRETS_SOCKET
